items.title: ?page=0 shows the first catalog page
covers: Expected: first catalog page is shown
items.reason: Core bug: page 0 made the WebApp request pageIndex=-1 and the page hung on the skeleton. Only the browser shows the skeleton and error bar, so this is e2e.

items.title: ?page=-1 shows the first catalog page
covers: Expected: first catalog page is shown
items.reason: Second reported input; a negative value goes through the same clamp but is a separate boundary from 0 (the WebApp sent pageIndex=-2 before the fix).

items.title: ?page=0 pager shows 1 / 2 with Prev disabled
covers: Expected: first catalog page is shown
items.reason: The pager derives Prev, Next and the status from the page number; a raw 0 would show 0 / 2 and a Prev link to page -1. Separate from the list contents (TC-01).

items.title: ?page=-1 pager shows 1 / 2 with Prev disabled
covers: Expected: first catalog page is shown
items.reason: A negative value could yield a Prev link to a more negative page or a status like -1 / 2; asserts the clamp reaches the pager for negatives too.

items.title: Next from ?page=0 goes to page 2
covers: Code map: Next link uses CurrentPage
Expected: first catalog page is shown
items.reason: Next is built from current + 1; if the clamp were missing it would point at page 1 (0 + 1) and the user would be stuck. Verifies navigation continues from the clamped page.

items.title: ?page=1 still shows the first page
items.reason: Boundary just above the clamped values; guards against an off-by-one in Math.Max(1, ...) that would shift page 1.

items.title: ?page=2 still shows the second page
covers: Boundary: valid pages unaffected by the clamp
items.reason: Regression guard: the clamp must not alter valid pages; page 2 must still request pageIndex 1.

items.title: Un-fixme'd spec and the rest of catalog-browse pass
covers: Acceptance Criteria 2: test.fixme removed, file still passes
items.reason: Acceptance criterion names this command explicitly; ensures the previously fixme'd tests run and the other tests in the file are not broken by the change.

items.title: Bug row removed from the bugs table in testing/flows/
covers: Acceptance Criteria 3: matching row removed from bugs table in testing/flows/
items.reason: Documentation acceptance criterion; a stale row would keep reporting a fixed bug. File inspection, no services needed.
